title: Specimen Collection Manual: Specimen Types, Stability Limits, Minimum Volumes and Retention
content:
Each service class of Laboratory Test Orders is drawn on one primary specimen type and has its own stability limits, minimum volume and retention period.

| Service class | Primary specimen type | Stability at room temperature (hours from collection) | Stability refrigerated (hours from collection) | Minimum volume (mL) | Retained after resulting (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | Serum | 8 | 72 | 1.0 | 7 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | Serum | 48 | 168 | 1.0 | 14 |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | Serum | 24 | 168 | 2.0 | 30 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | Swab | 72 | 168 | 1.0 | 7 |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | Urine | 168 | 720 | 30.0 | 30 |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | Tissue | 720 | 720 | 0.0 | 3650 |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | Whole blood (EDTA) | 168 | 504 | 3.0 | 60 |

## Definitions

- **Primary specimen type** — the specimen the class's tests are drawn on: serum, plasma (EDTA), whole blood (EDTA), urine, swab or tissue.
- **Stability limits** — the hours from collection for which a specimen stays acceptable, at room temperature and refrigerated.
- **Minimum volume** — the volume below which a specimen is rejected as *quantity not sufficient*. A figure of 0.0 mL means the class's acceptance is not volume-based.
- **Retention** — the calendar days the specimen (or block or slide) is kept after resulting.

## Points of comparison

- Refrigeration extends stability for every blood and swab class; for Anatomic Pathology & Cytology both limits are the same 720 hours.
- Clinical Toxicology Testing needs the largest specimen (30.0 mL of urine); Anatomic Pathology & Cytology has no volume minimum and keeps its material longest (3650 days).
- **Example (hypothetical).** A Routine Clinical Testing serum specimen kept at room temperature is within its limit for 8 hours from collection; the same specimen shipped refrigerated is within its limit for 72 hours.
